brief.note: Oil above $95 and rising yields pressured everything; the utility wildfire-liability selloff still dominates the screen.

candidates.name: Edison International
candidates.business: California electric utility serving Los Angeles through Southern California Edison
candidates.cause: State lawmakers advanced a wildfire bill omitting the liability protections investors expected, leaving Edison exposed to insurer subrogation claims from fires its equipment starts.
candidates.right: Lawmakers must revisit liability relief before the autumn wildfire season tests the balance sheet
candidates.wrong: A major fire season lands with no liability cap and financing costs spiral

candidates.name: PG&E Corporation
candidates.business: California utility supplying gas and electricity across northern and central California
candidates.cause: The amended state wildfire bill dropped the financing and liability fix utilities wanted, and brokers cut targets while raising their estimated liability drag.
candidates.right: The legislature must deliver a durable liability backstop in the next session
candidates.wrong: Wildfire claims mount again and PG&E revisits the balance-sheet stress of 2019

candidates.name: PayPal Holdings, Inc.
candidates.business: Online payments network running PayPal, Venmo and Braintree checkout
candidates.cause: A Stripe and Advent consortium abandoned its $53bn takeover at $60.50 a share after failing to agree a higher price, unwinding the bid premium.
candidates.right: Management must deliver the turnaround alone now that no buyer is bidding
candidates.wrong: Apple Pay and Google keep taking checkout share and branded volume keeps shrinking

candidates.name: Marvell Technology, Inc.
candidates.business: Designs custom silicon and networking chips for data centre operators
candidates.cause: Record Q2 revenue up 37% and raised guidance for both fiscal years, but the fiscal 2028 outlook fell short of what investors had priced in.
candidates.right: The raised fiscal 2028 revenue target must arrive with margins that justify 49x earnings
candidates.wrong: Custom silicon wins slip or a key customer designs Marvell out of its roadmap
